US Senator Lindsey Graham Dies at 71 After Brief and Sudden Illness

Lindsey Graham, a key ally of former US President Donald Trump, died on July 11 after a brief and sudden illness. He was 71 years old. Graham had served in the Senate since 2003 and was known for his sharp criticism of Trump before becoming one of his most loyal backers.
